notes: Adds Nintendo 64 libraries to Game Center with ParaLLEl N64 on Raspberry Pi and Mupen64Plus-Next on Linux and SteamOS.
Uses the standard RetroNAS retronas/roms layout by default and supports manufacturer folders such as roms/nintendo/gamecube and roms/nintendo/n64 across every game system and port.
Keeps existing MiSTer-style RetroNAS folder layouts supported while improving nested ROM discovery and desktop fallback caching.
Launches Dusklight through a managed Wayland display on headless Raspberry Pi systems, fixing the window and surface creation crash.
